levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: rule 11: this is al-Faqih's statement of his route («رويته عن أبي») to the book of Abu Kahmas, with no saying following
«ما كان فيه عن أبي كهمس» names what the book holds; it is not a transmitter at the start of the chain
«أبي» is a bare relation with no name; the blessing is left out
